events.title: Cemetery Simulator Is Alive and Digging into Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey, caretakers!It's been quiet since the demo, so let's clear one thing up first: Cemetery Simulator is very much alive. We're working on the full version every day, and much of that work comes straight from you.Thousands of you played the demo, and many took the time to write reviews, fill out our survey, and post on the forums. We read all of it. Your feedback became the backbone of our plans for the full game.Here's a small taste of what you asked for and what we're working on:Old mausoleums

events.title: Cemetery Simulator Digs Into Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello, gravekeepers.Cemetery Simulator has shuffled its way into Steam Next Fest, and the demo is open for business. Grab a shovel, tidy up the plots, dig a few holes, and put a friend to work in co-op while you are at it.Before anything else: thank you. A surprising number of you took the time to fill out our feedback survey, and we read all of it: the kind words, the bug reports, and the brutally honest "I wouldn't buy it in its current state."
